name: Slimy Doom
body:
Type disease, contact; Save Fortitude DC 14

Onset 1 day; Frequency 1/day

Effect 1d4 Con damage, target must make a second Fort save or 1 point of the damage is drain instead; Cure 2 consecutive saves
